origin: Vihtavuori's published powder data (energy content, bulk density) and load tables (tools/loaddata)
descr: Qex (energy content) and pcd (bulk density) as published by Vihtavuori; grain 2.3 x 1.3 mm, 15 % nitroglycerine. Burn rate Ba fitted to 164 start and maximum loads of Vihtavuori's published reloading data (9 cartridges), velocity error 4.5 % rms. Not published and therefore only typical or chosen values: k, material density pc, and the form function (a0, z1, z2: the combination that reproduces the velocities best, the data hardly determine it). Check every load against the manufacturer's current load data.
